added.name: DOTA_DarkCarnival_CrateDrop_GameDesc
added.value: Help Tinker catch the crates of automaton parts for assembly

added.name: DOTA_DarkCarnival_CrateDrop_HowToPlayInstructions
added.value:
Catch the crates of automaton parts onto the platform, while avoiding the bombs. Drop too many crates and lose!

Use Arrow Keys to move and Space to store the crates already caught.

added.name: DOTA_DarkCarnival_CrateDrop_Help_Move_Details
added.value: Move the platform with the left and right arrow keys, and switch tracks with up and down arrow keys.

added.name: DOTA_DarkCarnival_CrateDrop_Help_Ability_Description
added.value: Use Space to instantly transport caught crates to the assemblers, scoring points for each part.

added.name: DOTA_DarkCarnival_CrateDrop_Scoring_Desc
added.value: Every crate that was caught and collected with the Assemble ability grants 100,150 or 200 points, based on it's size and shape.\n\nIncrease the score multiplier by stacking crates as high as you can!

added.name: DOTA_DarkCarnival_CrateDrop_Tutorial_1
added.value: Move Tinker's Platform left and right to catch crates full of Automaton Parts!

added.name: DOTA_DarkCarnival_CrateDrop_Tutorial_2
added.value: Use Up and Down to warp and catch the crates on the opposite track.

added.name: DOTA_DarkCarnival_CrateDrop_Tutorial_3
added.value: Use Space Bar to collect the caught crates and score points!

added.name: DOTA_DarkCarnival_CrateDrop_LevelIntroText1
added.value: Use the Space Bar when the crates are stacked high to get a greater multiplier!

added.name: DOTA_DarkCarnival_CrateDrop_LevelIntroText2
added.value: Beware of hazards that can explode if touched!

added.name: DOTA_DarkCarnival_CrateDrop_LevelIntroText3
added.value: Catch the Defense Matrix powerup to deflect bombs!

added.name: DOTA_DarkCarnival_CrateDrop_LevelIntroText4
added.value: Beware of bombs that disintigrate all crates!

added.name: DOTA_DarkCarnival_CrateDrop_LevelIntroText5
added.value: Restore lost lives with the Repair powerup!

added.name: DOTA_DarkCarnival_CrateDrop_LevelIntroText6
added.value: Barrels full of goop will slow you down!

added.name: DOTA_DarkCarnival_BlimpJump_PostGame_Subtitle_LostStoryMode
added.value: You did not reach the blimp.

added.name: DOTA_DarkCarnival_BlimpJump_Scoring
added.value:
Only in Infinite mode.
Earn points by going higher and higher.

added.name: DOTA_DarkCarnival_BlimpJump_Modes_StoryMode_Details
added.value: Reach the Blimp at the top.

added.name: DOTA_DarkCarnival_BlimpJump_Modes_InfiniteMode_Details
added.value: Go as high as you can, shoot for the stars!
